title: Foundational basis of resource physical value: chemical exergy, concentration energy and statistical entropy calculations (Online Resource 4)
description:
Supporting data and code for the review article 'Resource Assessment methods in Industrial Ecology and Process Engineering: a critical review towards improved consideration in LCA' (Freboeuf, Sonnemann, Magdalena, Rechberger, Beylot). The repository contains Jupyter notebooks computing standard reference species chemical exergy across ten modelling configurations (producing Figs. 4 and 5 of the article), statistical entropy visualisations, and Cumulative Exergy Demand (CExD) calculations based on ecoinvent v3.12.

Funding: French National Research Agency (ANR) under France 2030, reference ANR-22-PERE-0003.
